title: [finding] EmptyStateSchema declares no action, so an empty list cannot name its next step (a docs link, a how-to); the console's only empty-state button is add-record
body:
Blocked-by: #23010

Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`), from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2776 dev report (cloud PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2793). ⛔ Not graded: grading is triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The claim

The maintainer accepted, for the cloud console's empty pages, "one plain sentence and one action" (objectstack-ai/cloud#2772 item 6 → objectstack-ai/cloud#2776, 「同意」). The ruling also says: if the spec cannot express it, the fix is contract-first in the spec, not a special case in objectui. The spec cannot express the action. An empty list can carry a title, a message and an icon, and nothing that leads anywhere. Where nobody can add a row (a list of connections a remote server registers, a list of packages a publisher pushes), the only button the console draws there, add-record, is off, so the empty state has no next step at all.

## Evidence

- `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` (`EmptyStateSchema`, `:1769` on `main` `6a7eca68`; `:1732-1772` at cloud's pin `56bf27affb`) is a strict object of `title`, `message` and `icon`. `EMPTY_STATE_ACTION_GUIDANCE` (`:1746`) states that the empty state renders text only, and that the add-record button is the renderer's.
- objectui `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:5518-5590` (at cloud's objectui pin `d758f2f2`): the `DataEmptyState` action slot is add-record only.
- Measured producers of `emptyState` today: cloud's `my_environments` (objectstack-ai/cloud#844), cloud's `connected_runtimes` (objectstack-ai/cloud#2793, text only because of this gap), and objectui's `managedByEmptyState`.

## What the consumer needs

One declared action in the empty state: a link (`label` + `url`), a closed shape refused at parse when malformed. For cloud#2776, the two links are "how to connect a self-hosted ObjectOS server" and "how to publish a package".

- A `url` target has to be one the console's action runner accepts: objectui's `ActionRunner.isValidUrl` refuses `mailto:` (objectstack-ai/objectui#12191).
- The renderer half is objectui's (`ListView.tsx`'s empty branch). A seam card in the usual order: spec first, then objectui.

## Alternatives the dev weighed (not chosen here)

- Hiding the empty pages instead. The nav `visible` scope binds only `current_user` and `features`, so it reads neither a plan nor a row count, and in cloud the plan is per environment, not per account. A data-reading nav gate would be new surface, and objectui's nav `visible` is fail-open. The dev recommended the action key over this.
- Stopping at text only (cloud PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2793 as it stands).

## Delivery note

Cloud's framework pin is held at `56bf27affb` until the v18 move (objectstack-ai/cloud#2709), so a fix reaches cloud with that move.

Dedupe: searched objectstack issues for `emptyState`, "empty state action" and `EmptyStateSchema`: no match.
